```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(logolink)
library(patchwork)
library(colorspace)
library(ggnewscale)

model_path <- "C:/Users/vsesu60/OneDrive - Linköpings universitet/Documents/R/vis-soc/netlogo/roads/Segregation Interventions.nlogox"
library(ggnewscale)

model_path <- "C:/Users/vsesu60/OneDrive - Linköpings universitet/Documents/R/vis-soc/netlogo/roads/Segregation Interventions.nlogox"

# 1. Parameter Grid for Post-Tick-400 Beta Values
scenarios <- tibble(
  beta1_neighbors  = c(1.00, 0.75, 0.50, 0.25, 0.00),
  beta2_venue_group = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
  scenario_label   = c(
    "1. Only Neighbors (1.0 / 0.0)",
    "2. High Neighbors (0.75 / 0.25)",
    "3. Balanced (0.50 / 0.50)",
    "4. High Venues (0.25 / 0.75)",
    "5. Only Venues (0.00 / 1.0)"
  )
)

constants <- list(
  "density-percent"             = 70,
  "number-of-ethnicities"       = 2,
  "proportion-majority"         = 60,
  "neighborhood-distance"       = 5,
  "venues-number"               = 18,
  "venue-catchment-distance"    = 7,
  "venue-exclusivity"           = 1.0,
  "proportion-of-integration"   = 100,
  "intervention-scenario"       = "emergent-venues",
  "travel-distance"             = 5,
  "road-multiplier"             = 1,
  "road-scenario"               = "empty",
  "road-density"                = 0,
  "parks-number"                = 0,
  "beta1-neighbors"   = scenarios$beta1_neighbors,
  "beta2-venue-group" = scenarios$beta2_venue_group,
  "beta3-venue-loc"             = 0,
  "beta4-home-venues"           = 0,
  "beta5-park-group"            = 0,
  "beta6-roads-group"           = 0,
  "random-seed?"                = TRUE
)

# 2. Setup BehaviorSpace via logolink
setup_file <- create_experiment(
  name = "Beta_Weight_Transition_Experiment",
  repetitions = 5,
  run_metrics_every_step = TRUE,
  setup = "setup",
  go = "go",
  time_limit = 800,
  metrics = c(
    "index-exposure", 
    "index-dissimilarity", 
    "index-clustering", 
    "index-concentration"
  ),
  constants = constants
)

raw_results <- model_path |> 
  run_experiment(setup_file = setup_file, output = "table")

# 3. Clean and Structure Data
results_df <- raw_results$table |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("index_"),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(metric = str_to_title(str_remove(metric, "index_")))
```


```{r}
run_scenarios <- results_df |>
  group_by(run_number) |>
  filter(step == max(step)) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(run_number, final_beta1 = beta1_neighbors, final_beta2 = beta2_venue_group) |>
  mutate(
    scenario_label = case_when(
      near(final_beta1, 1.00) & near(final_beta2, 0.00) ~ "1. Only Neighbors (1.0 / 0.0)",
      near(final_beta1, 0.75) & near(final_beta2, 0.25) ~ "2. High Neighbors (0.75 / 0.25)",
      near(final_beta1, 0.50) & near(final_beta2, 0.50) ~ "3. Balanced (0.50 / 0.50)",
      near(final_beta1, 0.25) & near(final_beta2, 0.75) ~ "4. High Venues (0.25 / 0.75)",
      near(final_beta1, 0.00) & near(final_beta2, 1.00) ~ "5. Only Venues (0.00 / 1.0)",
      TRUE ~ str_glue("Custom ({round(final_beta1, 2)} / {round(final_beta2, 2)})")
    )
  ) |> 
  select(-final_beta1, -final_beta2)

results_df <- results_df |>
  left_join(run_scenarios |> select(run_number, scenario_label), by = "run_number")

# Mean trajectory by scenario and metric
mean_trajectories <- results_df |>
  group_by(step, metric, scenario_label) |>
  summarize(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_trajectories <- ggplot() +
  # Warm-up reference band
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 400, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "gray95", alpha = 0.8) +
  # Individual simulation runs
  geom_line(
    data = results_df,
    aes(x = step, y = value, group = interaction(run_number, scenario_label), color = scenario_label),
    alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  # Mean scenario lines
  geom_line(
    data = mean_trajectories,
    aes(x = step, y = mean_val, color = scenario_label),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 400, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  annotate("text", x = 410, y = Inf, label = "Venues Added & Betas Switched", 
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "gray20") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Post-400 Beta Mix") +
  labs(
    title = "Sustaining Segregation: Neighborhood Proximity vs. Venue Affiliation",
    subtitle = "Ticks 0–400: Baseline Emergence (Beta1 = 0.5, Beta2 = 0) | Ticks 400–800: Venue Mechanisms",
    x = "Simulation Tick",
    y = "Index Value"
  ) +
  xlim(300, 800)+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Terminal State Boxplot (Step 800 Distribution)
p_terminal <- results_df |>
  filter(step == 800) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = scenario_label, y = value, fill = scenario_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Final Segregation State at Tick 800",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Index Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

final_plot <- p_trajectories / p_terminal + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1.2))
print(final_plot)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# 1. Target trade-off levels to filter down to 5 scenarios
target_scenarios <- tibble(
  beta1 = c(1.00, 0.75, 0.50, 0.25, 0.00),
  beta2 = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
  clean_label = factor(
    c(
      "Neighbors Only (1.0 / 0.0)",
      "High Neighbors (0.75 / 0.25)",
      "Equal Mix (0.50 / 0.50)",
      "High Venues (0.25 / 0.75)",
      "Venues Only (0.00 / 1.0)"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "Neighbors Only (1.0 / 0.0)",
      "High Neighbors (0.75 / 0.25)",
      "Equal Mix (0.50 / 0.50)",
      "High Venues (0.25 / 0.75)",
      "Venues Only (0.00 / 1.0)"
    )
  )
)

# 2. Filter data directly without pivoting
filtered_df <- results_df |>
  group_by(run_number) |>
  mutate(
    final_b1 = beta1_neighbors[step == max(step)][1],
    final_b2 = beta2_venue_group[step == max(step)][1]
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  inner_join(target_scenarios, by = c("final_b1" = "beta1", "final_b2" = "beta2")) |>
  mutate(
    metric = str_remove(metric, "^index[_-]"),
    metric = str_to_title(metric),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Dissimilarity", "Clustering", "Exposure", "Concentration"))
  )

# 3. Calculate summary trajectories (Median + IQR ribbons)
summary_trajectories <- filtered_df |>
  filter(step >= 300) |>
  group_by(step, metric, clean_label) |>
  summarize(
    median_val = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4. Trajectory Plot
p_trajectories <- ggplot(summary_trajectories, aes(x = step, color = clean_label, fill = clean_label)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median_val), linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 400, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  annotate("text", x = 408, y = Inf, label = "Venues Added (Tick 400)", 
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.6, size = 3.5, color = "gray30", fontface = "italic") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.9, name = "Post-400 Weights (β1 / β2)") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.9, name = "Post-400 Weights (β1 / β2)") +
  labs(
    title = "Macro Segregation Dynamics Under Venue vs. Neighbor Utility",
    subtitle = "Ribbons show IQR across runs | Equilibrium reached before tick 400",
    x = "Simulation Tick",
    y = "Index Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )


# 6. Combined View
p_trajectories

ggsave(p_trajectories,filename =  "venues_location_relaxation.png", 
       width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300, 
       bg = "white")
```


### Venue exclusivity and relaxation 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(logolink)

# 1. Define Factorial Conditions (5 beta pairs x 4 exclusivity levels = 20 scenarios)
beta_pairs <- tibble(
  beta1_target = c(1.00, 0.75, 0.50, 0.25, 0.00),
  beta2_target = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
  beta_label   = factor(
    c("Neighbors Only (1.0 / 0.0)", 
      "High Neighbors (0.75 / 0.25)", 
      "Equal Mix (0.50 / 0.50)", 
      "High Venues (0.25 / 0.75)", 
      "Venues Only (0.00 / 1.0)"),
    levels = c("Neighbors Only (1.0 / 0.0)", 
               "High Neighbors (0.75 / 0.25)", 
               "Equal Mix (0.50 / 0.50)", 
               "High Venues (0.25 / 0.75)", 
               "Venues Only (0.00 / 1.0)")
  )
)

exclusivity_levels <- tibble(
  exclusivity = c(1.00, 0.75, 0.25, 0.00),
  excl_label  = factor(
    c("Strict (1.0)", "High (0.75)", "Low (0.25)", "Universal (0.0)"),
    levels = c("Strict (1.0)", "High (0.75)", "Low (0.25)", "Universal (0.0)")
  )
)

scenarios_2f <- crossing(beta_pairs, exclusivity_levels)

# 2. Base Model Constants
base_constants <- list(
  "density-percent"           = 70,
  "number-of-ethnicities"     = 2,
  "proportion-majority"       = 60,
  "neighborhood-distance"     = 5,
  "venues-number"             = 18,
  "venue-catchment-distance"  = 7,
  "proportion-of-integration" = 100,
  "intervention-scenario"     = "emergent-venues",
  "travel-distance"           = 5,
  "road-multiplier"           = 1,
  "road-scenario"             = "empty",
  "road-density"              = 0,
  "parks-number"              = 0,
  "beta3-venue-loc"           = 0,
  "beta4-home-venues"         = 0,
  "beta5-park-group"          = 0,
  "beta6-roads-group"         = 0,
  "random-seed?"              = TRUE
)

# 3. Execution Pipeline
results_2f <- scenarios_2f |>
  mutate(batch_id = row_number()) |>
  pmap(function(beta1_target, beta2_target, beta_label, exclusivity, excl_label, batch_id) {
    run_constants <- c(
      base_constants,
      list(
        "beta1-neighbors"   = beta1_target,
        "beta2-venue-group" = beta2_target,
        "venue-exclusivity" = exclusivity
      )
    )
    
    setup_file <- create_experiment(
      name = paste0("Exp_Batch_", batch_id),
      repetitions = 5,
      run_metrics_every_step = TRUE,
      setup = "setup",
      go = "go",
      time_limit = 800,
      metrics = c("index-exposure", "index-dissimilarity", "index-clustering", "index-concentration"),
      constants = run_constants
    )
    
    # Extract [["table"]] from the logolink output list before calling mutate
    raw_output <- model_path |>
      run_experiment(setup_file = setup_file, output = "table")
    
    raw_output[["table"]] |>
      mutate(
        beta_label = beta_label,
        excl_label = excl_label,
        venue_exclusivity = exclusivity
      )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

save(results_2f, scenarios_2f, file = "results_2f_experiment.RData")
```
